description: Windows 11 x64 utility for live hardware monitoring, system tweaks, debloating, storage management, and app installs.
notes: The official Inno Setup installer is extracted with Scoop's innounp helper; Setup is not executed and its [Run] entries are not launched.
The optional PawnIO driver is not installed by this extraction manifest. Kernel's CPU temperature, power, and clock sensor readings require PawnIO separately.
Kernel requests administrator privileges when launched and can change Windows settings. Review each tweak before applying it; create a restore point first.
